messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — prod-az4-heartbeat-loss (sev2). Trigger time 6112233445. Auto-escalation in 2m if unacked. Affected: AZ4 control plane heartbeats, some routing flaps, ~7% traffic drop.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident P-90721 created — auto-escalation rules applied.

tay (SRE oncall): ack — I'm on it. Taking lead for initial triage.

mohit: acked. I can help with routing divert and cache checks.

tay (SRE oncall): quick status: heartbeat stream shows intermittent timeouts to az4 fabric. Running initial health probe and listing node statuses: `kubectl -n internal get pods -o wide --field-selector=spec.nodeName=az4-*`.

tay (SRE oncall): paste: 
```
NAME        RESTARTS AGE NODE
router-1    5        2d  az4-node-a
router-2    0        4h  az4-node-b
controller  12       3h  az4-node-c
```

elena (ops): monitored customer-facing frontends in eu-west show elevated latency and a few 504 reports. CS seeing inbound tickets.

jun (platform-lead): recommend immediate traffic divert from az4 -> az2/az3. Start canary at 25% then scale if stable. Need SRE ack to execute.

tay (SRE oncall): executing canary divert now. Running runbook step: `./routingctl divert --from az4 --to az2 --percent 25`.

ops-bot: routingctl invoked by tay, config hash abc123, divert 25% initiated — monitoring route convergence.

rob (CS): drafting status update for status.redwood.ai: "We are investigating increased errors for customers routed via EU AZ4. We are diverting traffic to healthy zones; no data loss expected. Updates every 15 minutes." Any changes?

mohit: will watch KV cache miss rates and prefix cache rehydration. If misses spike we may pause the ramp.

tay (SRE oncall): canary 25% -> metrics: error-rate for diverted requests down ~35%, latency improving. No cache thrash so far. Proceeding to ramp per Jun's call.

jun (platform-lead): authorize ramp to 100% now. Also request emergency autoscale headroom in az2.

elena (ops): posting status update now and notifying affected customers.

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by tay (SRE oncall) at 6112233447.

tay (SRE oncall): divert 100% executed. `routingctl status` shows az4 traffic reduced to ~1-2% (draining), az2/az3 handling +12% load.

mohit: KV cache on az2 warmed, small rehydration spike observed but within thresholds. Watching for index rebuilds.

tay (SRE oncall): initiating controlled drain of az4 nodes to avoid split-brain: `nodectl cordon az4-* && nodectl drain --timeout 600s` — will keep drains staggered.

jun (platform-lead): infra request in flight to provision emergency capacity in az2: `infra-bot create-spot-pool --region eu-west --gpus 8 --label emergency-az2`.

infra-bot: provisioning acknowledged; pool creation started (req id p-az2-emerg-6112). ETA ~12 minutes.

elena (ops): CS update appended: mitigation in place, divert active, ETA 60m for stabilization and deeper investigation. Rob pls add any enterprise notices.

rob (CS): logged one enterprise SLA query; billing alerted for potential credit path.

tay (SRE oncall): monitoring for control plane recovery. If az4 control plane returns healthy for 15m and node health OK, plan slow shift back 25% increments as per runbook.

mohit: suspect root cause: NIC fabric flap or upstream provider switching event. Collecting provider telemetry and switch firmware logs.

jun (platform-lead): assigning eng-owner for runtime-level investigation: @maria (serving runtime) — please collect kernel, driver, and runtime logs from az4 nodes.

maria (serving-runtime): on it, gathering dmesg, ethtool, and runtime traces.

tay (SRE oncall): handoff note: I'm scheduled to be paged off at 6112233550 to morning coverage. @mohit I'm handing primary to you but will remain available until safe handback.

mohit: taking over primary. ack. I will keep channel triaged and run post-divert checks.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident status changed to "mitigated" — traffic diversion active; auto-close timer set for 30m if no regressions.

tay (SRE oncall): leaving channel (oncall handoff). Nice work everyone. :tada:

mohit: continuing active monitoring. Will post a second status update at +30m and start RCA timeline once logs collected.

elena (ops): summary for ops doc: mitigation = traffic divert to az2/az3, controlled drain of az4, infra provisioning for capacity, CS notifications sent. Next: vendor correlation and bridge with serving-runtime team.

maria (serving-runtime): uploaded logs to s3://redwood-incident-logs/p-90721/ and started correlation script.

mohit: closing note before next update: no customer data loss, latency improved for diverted traffic, mitigation stable. Continuing until we can either failback safely or schedule maintenance window for az4 recovery.
